text: The remains of a broken fire rite. Its blows set you alight.
Ashbound walk Overworld forests at night, and in the March they roam the Steppe and the Ember Wastes.
It has **24 health** and **2 armour** and hits for **4**. Each hit sets you on fire for 2 seconds, and it is immune to fire itself. Keep water close, or fight it where you can step into a pool.
pages.title: Where and how

text: An Ember Heart attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: No charm will bond an Ashbound. Light your paths and it stays away.
pages.title: It will not bond
